sections.Profile:
Arabian Knights is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1953. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1953
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Foreign Peoples, Single Player, Women, Original Theme
